How This Works

  1. 1Choose 3 variables you think predict box office best.
  2. 2Inspect the fitted regression model and its prediction.
  3. 3The executive adds 3 more variables — allocate a £100m budget across all 6.
  4. 4Reveal the true outcome and see your prediction error and profit.
Every film in the dataset is synthetic — some variables genuinely drive box office, others are mostly noise. Your job is to tell them apart.
Synthetic dataset · n = 200 · for classroom use only
